notes: Cognitive walkthrough (four-question variant) of journey book-a-slot at 375 px light; record at cw/book-a-slot.json. 13 steps walked, 6 failed, journey verdict would_with_effort. All candidates are E0 failure-point hypotheses. The journey file's _comment names a ground-truth file; it was not opened. Probe directories are relative to runs/20261016-230412-audit-standard/.

strengths.title: Check-and-book summary repeats day, 09:20 to 09:40, vehicle and waste with 'Change slot' / 'Change vehicle' links, so a first-time resident can check the booking before committing
Field hints on the details step say why each item is asked ('For a reminder the evening before', 'To confirm you live in the district') and give a registration example
Day quick-picks use the resident's own words ('Saturday 17', 'Tomorrow') in the first screen on a phone

candidates.title: Slot area stays blank and labelled with today's date while another day's slots load
candidates.description: A day choice should be acknowledged at once and a wait should be shown. After tapping 'Saturday 17' the button turns pressed, but for about 0.9 s the slot area is empty and the line under 'Slots' still reads 'Monday 12 October'; no loading indicator or text appears. The same blank 'Slots' area shows on first load with 'Today' pressed.
candidates.impact: A first-time resident who does not know slots take a moment may read the blank, Monday-labelled area as 'nothing free on Saturday' or as a failed tap, and tap again or pick another day.

scope.task: book a Saturday morning slot for a car

evidence.detail: click Saturday 17; screenshot at 400 ms shows Saturday pressed, 'Monday 12 October', no slots; .slot visible ~0.9 s after click
expect .slot visible took 921 ms after click

factor_notes.impact: first step of the critical journey; misread as no availability
factor_notes.persistence: new and occasional users meet it each time

candidates.recommendation: Update the date line immediately and show a 'Loading Saturday's slots…' state in the slot area until the slots arrive.

candidates.title: 'Few left' slots are shown first in an unheaded block that mixes morning and afternoon, ahead of the 'Morning' list
candidates.description: Times should be scannable in time order under clear headings. On Saturday the first block under '22 slots free' holds the ten 'Few left' slots (08:20 … 10:40, 13:40, 14:00, 15:00, 16:40) with no heading; the 'Morning' heading and the remaining morning slots (08:00, 09:20, 10:00) follow below it, so 09:20 sits around 1150 px down at 375 px. The accessibility tree lists the slots in time order under 'Morning'/'Afternoon', so the visual order differs from the reading order.
candidates.impact: A resident looking for a Saturday-morning time may not notice that more morning slots exist below the mixed block, may scan afternoon times while looking for morning, and a screen-reader user hears a different order from what a sighted helper sees.

scope.task: book a Saturday morning slot for a car

evidence.detail: full page at 375 px: unheaded 'Few left' block above 'Morning'
group 'Slots': heading Morning, 08:00, 08:20 Few left, … in time order

factor_notes.frequency: every day with any 'Few left' slots
factor_notes.impact: slows finding the wanted time; may lead to a less suitable slot

candidates.recommendation: Keep every slot in time order under 'Morning' and 'Afternoon' and mark scarcity on the slot itself rather than pulling those slots into a separate block.

candidates.title: 'Few left' badge on a single 20-minute slot has no clear meaning
candidates.description: Labels should match the user's model. The page says a slot is the 20-minute window one arrives in, and a resident thinks of one slot as one booking; yet individual slots carry an orange 'Few left' badge (accessible name e.g. '08:20 Few left'). Nothing explains how a single slot can have 'few left' or whether those slots differ from plain ones.
candidates.impact: A first-time resident may hesitate over which slots are safe to pick, or read the orange badge as a warning against choosing them.

scope.task: book a Saturday morning slot for a car

candidates.recommendation: Say what the badge means in the resident's terms, or drop it if each slot holds one vehicle.

candidates.title: Vehicle step does not show the day and time just chosen
candidates.description: After a choice is made, the next step should confirm it. /vehicle.html shows the step list, vehicle and waste questions and 'Back to the slots', but no day or time; the chosen Saturday 17 October, 09:20 is first repeated only on the check-and-book step.
candidates.impact: A resident cannot tell from this step whether their 09:20 Saturday choice was taken, and may go back to check, losing time on a held slot.

scope.task: book a Saturday morning slot for a car

evidence.detail: main on /vehicle.html contains no date, time or 'Saturday' text; searched default and car-chosen and info-open states (probes/4, probes/8)

candidates.recommendation: Repeat the chosen day and time at the top of the vehicle step.

candidates.title: How long a chosen slot is held is never stated, and the expiry error does not say the hold ran out
candidates.description: When a reservation is held for a limited time, users should be told the limit before it matters and told why it ended. No step from choosing 09:20 to 'Book this slot' mentions a hold or its length. When the hold has lapsed, submitting shows 'There is a problem / This slot is no longer available.' and blanks the slot line to '—', without saying the hold expired or how to get a slot again beyond the 'Change slot' link.
candidates.impact: A resident filling the form on a phone while doing something else may lose the slot without warning and not understand why, then have to start choosing again for a scarce Saturday slot.

scope.task: book a Saturday morning slot for a car

locations.snippet: This slot is no longer available.

evidence.detail: no 'held', 'hold', 'minutes' (other than slot length) or timer text on /, /vehicle.html or /confirm.html in default states
expired route: fill details, Book this slot → alert 'This slot is no longer available.', slot shown as '—'

factor_notes.frequency: any booking that takes longer than the hold
factor_notes.persistence: every booking until the limit is learned

candidates.recommendation: State the hold length when the slot is chosen and on later steps, and word the expiry error as 'We held 09:20 for N minutes; it has been released' with a direct way to pick again.

candidates.title: Permit number field stays visible and unexplained after 'Car' is chosen
candidates.description: Fields that do not apply should not appear required. On /vehicle.html the 'Permit number' field ('Starts DRC-, then five digits.') shows before any vehicle is chosen and remains unchanged after 'Car' is pressed, with no 'only for vans and trailers' text beside it. The rule is only in a panel behind an icon-only (i) button named 'About vans and trailers'. Next proceeds with the field empty.
candidates.impact: A car owner without a permit may think they need one and stop to apply for a permit they do not need, or abandon the booking.

evidence.detail: button "Car" [pressed]; textbox "Permit number" present; rule only in expanded 'About vans and trailers'
Next with Car and empty permit reaches /confirm.html

candidates.recommendation: Show the permit field only for 'Car with trailer' and 'Van', with the permit rule in visible text.

candidates.title: No busy state for about 1.5 s after 'Book this slot' is tapped
candidates.description: A submit should be acknowledged at once. After tapping 'Book this slot' the page stays as it was (same button label, fields editable, no spinner or message) for about 1.5 s until the done page loads.
candidates.impact: A resident on mobile data may tap again or think the booking failed, risking a duplicate attempt or abandoning at the final step.

candidates.recommendation: Disable the button and show 'Booking…' on tap until the result arrives.

candidates.title: Booking confirmation omits the booked day, time and vehicle and the arrive-within-slot rule
candidates.description: The page meant to be shown at the gate should state what was booked. /done.html shows 'Booked', the reference, 'Show this at the gate…', the reminder number and directions, but not the day (Saturday 17 October), the time (09:20 to 09:40), the vehicle or registration, nor that the resident must arrive within the 20-minute slot.
candidates.impact: A resident reading the confirmation from their phone on Saturday, possibly with poor signal at the centre, cannot check from it when they are due, and may arrive outside the slot and be turned away.
